goals.title: Goals & challenges
goals.emptyBody: Set a simple target, like 3 workouts a week. You can change it at any time.
goals.pickExercise: Choose an exercise for this goal.
goals.freeLimit: Free plan: up to {{max}} active goals.
goals.principle: Goals are here to encourage you, never to pressure you. Rest days are part of training, and skipping a session when you are tired, in pain or injured is the right call.

challenges.title: Challenges
challenges.expired: Time's up — no worries, you can start over whenever you like.
challenges.safety: Challenges always leave room for rest days. Listen to your body: never train through pain or an injury to complete a challenge.

seven_day.name: 7-Day Workout Challenge
seven_day.desc: Complete {{count}} sessions within {{days}} days — rest days included.

thirty_day.name: 30-Day Fitness Challenge
thirty_day.desc: Complete {{count}} sessions (workouts or cardio) within {{days}} days.

hundred_sessions.name: 100 Workout Sessions
hundred_sessions.desc: Reach {{count}} sessions at your own pace. No time limit.

weekly_consistency.name: Weekly Consistency
weekly_consistency.desc: Hit your weekly target ({{weekly}} active days) {{count}} weeks in a row.

personal_record.name: Personal Record Challenge
personal_record.desc: Beat {{count}} personal records within {{days}} days. Estimates don't count.

steady_month.name: Steady month
steady_month.desc: Reach your weekly target 4 weeks in a row.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Plan your workouts, log every set and watch your progress — all on your phone.

point.plan: Build programs or start from 30+ templates
point.track: Log sets, weights and rest with big, simple controls
point.progress: See your records, stats and body progress

onboarding.privacyNote: No account needed. Your data stays on this device.

levelDesc.beginner: New to training, or getting back into it
levelDesc.intermediate: Training regularly for a few months

onboarding.weeklyHint: A realistic target you can keep. 2–4 days is a great start.
onboarding.unitsBody: Choose your units. They are independent from the app language.

safety.advice: FitTrack gives general information and examples, not medical advice or a personal prescription. If you have a health condition, ask a professional before starting a new program.
safety.pain: Stop an exercise if you feel pain, dizziness or discomfort. Rest days matter.
safety.estimates: Some numbers are estimates (like the 1-rep max or calories) and are always labelled as such.
safety.private: Your workouts, measurements and photos stay on your device.

home.title: Ready to train?
home.noPlanned: Nothing planned. Start your current program or plan your week.
home.noProgram: Pick a template or create your own program to get started.
home.restNote: Rest days are part of training: your weekly streak is what counts.
home.noHistoryBody: Your completed workouts will show up here.
home.cardioSub: Log a run, ride or swim

workouts.freeLimit: Free plan: {{used}} of {{max}} own programs. Programs made from templates don't count.
workouts.noProgramsBody: Create one from scratch, or start from a template and adapt it.

library.equipmentHint: Shows exercises you can do with only the selected equipment (bodyweight is always included).
library.emptyBody: Try another word or remove a filter.
library.emptyFavorites: Tap the star on an exercise to add it to your favorites.

exercise.safety: Move with control and stop if you feel pain. These instructions are general guidance, not medical advice.
exercise.noHistoryBody: Log this exercise in at least two workouts to see your progression.
exercise.deleteCustomBody: If it's used in your history or programs it will be hidden instead, so your history stays intact.

templates.intro: Ready-made programs to start quickly. Every template becomes your own editable program.
templates.disclaimer: Templates are general examples, not medical or personalized training prescriptions. Adjust loads and volume to how you feel.

builder.name: Program name
builder.deleteDayBody: Delete "{{name}}" and its exercises? Past workouts are kept.
builder.emptyDayBody: Add exercises from the library, then set sets, reps and rest.
builder.deleteBody: Your past workouts and records are kept.
builder.reorderHint: Use the arrows to reorder exercises. Changes are saved automatically.

planner.weekSummary: This week: {{done}} done, {{planned}} planned — target {{target}} active days.
planner.noProgramsBody: Create a program or use a template first, then plan it here.

routine.title: Weekly routine
routine.intro: Choose what you usually do each day. FitTrack plans it every week; you can still move or skip any day.
routine.targetHint: Number of active days you aim for each week.
routine.autoFillHint: Fill your workout days with a program's days in order (A, B, C…).
routine.restNote_one: {{count}} workout day per week. Remember to keep rest days between hard sessions.
routine.restNote_other: {{count}} workout days per week. Remember to keep rest days between hard sessions.

invalidSet.weight_reps: Enter at least 1 rep (weight can be 0 for bodyweight).
invalidSet.distance_time: Enter a duration or a distance.

workout.discardBody: The sets of this workout will be deleted.
workout.finishBody: You completed {{done}} of {{total}} sets. Unfinished exercises are kept as they are.
workout.finishEmptyBody: No set was logged, so nothing will be saved.
workout.allDoneBody: Great work. Finish and save this workout?
workout.emptyBody: Add exercises to this day before starting.
workout.alreadyActiveBody: Finish or discard it before starting another one.
workout.safety: Listen to your body: stop if you feel pain or dizziness.

summary.title: Workout complete
summary.recover: Hydrate, eat well and rest — that's when progress happens.

history.title: History
history.deleteBody: Its sets are removed and your records are recalculated.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.emptyBody: Complete a workout or log cardio to see your statistics.
stats.distributionA11y: Share of completed sets by muscle group
stats.distributionNote: Based on the number of completed sets per exercise category.
stats.monthlyA11y: Sessions per month over the last 12 months
stats.honesty: Statistics only use what you logged. Periods without data are shown as empty, never filled in.

records.title: Personal records
records.intro: Your best logged performances. The first time you log an exercise sets your starting point.
records.emptyBody: Log sets in a workout: your bests will appear here.
records.estimateNote: Estimated 1RM uses the Epley formula (weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30)) on sets of 1–10 reps. It is an estimate, not a measured lift.

body.title: Body progress
body.privacy: Optional and private: these numbers never leave your device and are never used for ads or analytics.
body.emptyBody: Add a first measurement to start your history.
body.compareHint: Choose an earlier date to compare with the latest measurement.
body.valueOutOfRange: This value looks unusual — please check the number and the unit.
body.noDiagnosis: FitTrack shows your measurements as they are and does not interpret them. For health questions, talk to a professional.

photos.title: Progress photos
photos.sub: Private photos to compare over time
photos.privacy: Photos are stored only in FitTrack's private storage on this device. They are never uploaded or shared, and are not included in backups.
photos.compareHint: Tap two photos to compare them side by side. Long-press to delete.
photos.itemHint: Tap to compare, long-press to delete
photos.emptyBody: Photos can show changes that numbers miss.
photos.deleteBody: The file is permanently deleted from your device.
photos.deniedBody: You can allow camera access in Android settings, or pick a photo from your gallery.
photos.error: The photo could not be saved.

cardio.title: Cardio
cardio.emptyBody: Log a run, a walk, a ride or a swim — duration and distance are enough.
cardio.chartA11y: Cardio minutes per week over the last 8 weeks
cardio.recordsHint: Filter by activity type to compare similar activities.
cardio.honesty: FitTrack has no sensor: it doesn't measure heart rate or calories. Speed and pace are calculated from the duration and distance you enter.
cardio.computedNote: Calculated from your duration and distance.
cardio.estimateNeedsWeight: Add your body weight in Body progress to get an optional calorie estimate.
cardio.caloriesNote: Calorie estimates use standard MET values × your body weight × duration. Real expenditure varies a lot from person to person: treat it as a rough indication only.

errors.duration: Enter a duration (for example 30 for 30 minutes).
errors.speed: Speed over 100 km/h: please check the distance unit and the duration.

tools.title: Timers & tools

tabata.name: Tabata
tabata.desc: 8 × 20 s work / 10 s rest by default

tools.resetToEdit: Reset the timer to change its settings.
tools.backgroundNote: The timer keeps the right time even if you leave the app or lock your phone.

notifications.privacy: Notifications are created on your device and never contain your measurements or performance data.

workout_reminder.title: Workout reminders
workout_reminder.desc: On days with a planned workout

weekly_goal.title: Weekly goal check-in
weekly_goal.desc: A friendly weekly reminder of your goal

challenge.title: Challenge reminders
challenge.desc: Every other day while a challenge runs

progress_summary.title: Weekly progress summary
progress_summary.desc: Invites you to look at your week (optional)

notifications.workoutHint: Uses the session's time when you set one in the planner.
notifications.deniedBody: Allow notifications for FitTrack in Android settings to receive reminders.

workout.title: Workout planned today
workout.body: Your session is ready whenever you are.

routine.title: Time to move
routine.body: Your routine is waiting — even a short session counts.

weeklyGoal.title: Your weekly goal
weeklyGoal.body: Open FitTrack to see where you are this week.

challenge.title: Challenge in progress
challenge.body: Check your challenge progress. Rest days are fine too.

summary.title: Your week in FitTrack
summary.body: Take a look at your week's progress.

profile.premiumPitch: Unlimited programs, detailed statistics, advanced timers, progress photos and no ads.

settings.unitsNote: Your data is stored in metric units and converted for display, so switching units never changes your history.
settings.restNotificationSub: A notification when the rest ends while the app is in the background

data.localOnly: All your data is stored on this device. Uninstalling the app deletes it, so keep a backup.
data.backupBody: Export everything to a file you keep wherever you like, and restore it on this or another phone. Always free.
data.photosNote: Progress photos are not included in backups (they never leave your device).
data.csvBody: Workouts, cardio and measurements as spreadsheets (metric units).
data.exportError: The export failed. Please try again.
data.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
data.restoreBody: Backup from {{date}}: {{sessions}} workouts, {{programs}} programs, {{measurements}} measurements, {{cardio}} cardio activities. Your current data will be replaced.
data.restoreFailed: Nothing was changed: the backup could not be restored.
data.deleteExplain: Deletes workouts, programs, measurements, photos, goals and settings from this device. Purchases are not affected and can be restored.
data.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you want to keep your data.

points.local: Your data is stored locally on your phone. FitTrack has no server and needs no account.
points.noAccount: Nothing is synced or uploaded automatically.
points.noHealthShare: Body measurements, weights and performances are never sent to analytics or advertising partners.
points.photos: Progress photos stay in private app storage and are never shared.
points.ads: Free version: non-personalized ads only on browsing screens, never during a workout. Premium removes them.

privacy.analyticsSub: Helps improve the app (screens used, crashes). Never personal or fitness data. Off by default.

oneRm.title: Estimated one-rep max (1RM)
oneRm.body: Epley formula: weight × (1 + reps ÷ 30), only for sets of 1 to 10 reps. It is an estimate shown with a dashed line, never a measured lift. Never test a true maximum without proper preparation and a spotter.

volume.title: Volume
volume.body: Weight × reps of a set. Bodyweight sets have no volume.

pace.title: Speed and pace
pace.body: Calculated only from the duration and distance you enter. FitTrack does not use GPS or sensors.

calories.title: Calories
calories.body: Optional. Either the value you type, or an estimate: MET value × body weight × hours (Compendium of Physical Activities). Treat estimates as a rough indication.

streaks.title: Streaks
streaks.body: Weekly streaks count weeks reaching your target number of active days, so rest days never break them.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.body: Computed only from your logged data, on your device. Nothing is extrapolated.

about.disclaimer: FitTrack is a training log and planner. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or personalized prescriptions. Templates are general examples. Consult a qualified professional before starting a new program if you have any health concern, and stop exercising if you feel pain.

premium.advancedLibraryBody: Detailed instructions for advanced exercises are part of Premium.
premium.customExercisesBody: The free plan includes {{max}} custom exercises. Premium removes the limit.
premium.detailedStatsBody: Muscle-group distribution, monthly and yearly evolution and full history with Premium.
premium.fullHistoryBody: {{count}} older workouts are safely kept. Premium shows history beyond {{days}} days.
premium.historyLimited: Free plan: showing the last {{days}} days. Older data is kept and shown with Premium.
premium.bodyBody: Track every measurement, add your own and compare dates with Premium.
premium.bodyFree: Free plan: body weight and waist. Premium unlocks every measurement.
premium.photosBody: Keep private progress photos and compare them side by side with Premium.
premium.timersBody: Interval, Tabata and EMOM timers are part of Premium. Rest timer, stopwatch and countdown stay free.
premium.csvBody: Export your workouts, cardio and measurements as spreadsheets with Premium. JSON backup stays free.

paywall.title: FitTrack Premium
paywall.subtitle: Everything you need to train with a plan and see your progress.
paywall.limitSubtitle: You've reached the {{max}} programs of the free plan.

benefits.library: Advanced exercise library and unlimited custom exercises
benefits.body: Every body measurement + private progress photos

paywall.freeStays: The free plan stays useful: library, workout tracking, rest timer, basic statistics and backups.
paywall.pending: Purchase pending — it will activate once confirmed.
paywall.unavailable: The store is not available right now. Please try again later.
paywall.notConfigured: Purchases are not available in this build.
paywall.legal: Payment is charged to your Google Play account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in Google Play settings.
